meta.name: browser
meta.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作真实浏览器,完成点击、填表、截图与页面检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要让程序替你在真实网站上点击、填表或采集数据。
copy.tagline_en: Automate a real browser to click, fill forms, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need a program to click, fill forms, or scrape real websites.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能驱动一个真实浏览器:在你已登录的网站上操作页面、填表点击、截图、做网页 QA;遇到登录、验证码或 OTP 时把页面交给你亲自完成。
howto.when: 当你需要交互式浏览器操作时接管,比如在你已登录的站点上操作、填表点击或截图;普通搜索和无阻碍的静态抓取不走它。

say.text: 帮我在我已登录的站点上填好这张表并提交
say.note: 它会驱动你当前的浏览器,默认不抢焦点

say.text: 打开这个页面截个图给我看
say.note: 返回截图的 buffer 和宽高

say.text: 登录这步我自己来,把页面交给我
say.note: 它会用 requestHelp 请你手动完成

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives a real browser via the omowright library: acting on sites you're already signed into, filling forms and clicking, taking screenshots, and doing web QA. For login, CAPTCHA or OTP it hands the page to you.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any interactive browser task, such as acting on a signed-in site, filling forms or taking screenshots. Not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

say_en.text: Fill in and submit this form on a site I'm already signed into
say_en.note: Drives your current browser; focused is false by default

say_en.text: Open this page and take a screenshot for me
I'll handle the login myself - hand the page over
